name: HIGH-VIX armed contrarian long — negative-funding capitulation flush
rationale: Thesis: when macro fear is high (VIX gt vix_floor) AND perp funding has gone deeply negative (lt funding_floor), longs are paying shorts — a crowded-short, over-hedged flush that mean-reverts violently once the panic exhales. The VIX arm distinguishes a true risk-off capitulation from routine negative-carry noise. Both features BOUNDED, used as level gates (no drift). Exit when funding normalizes back above funding_exit, or risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (is VIX load-bearing?): the identical deep-negative-funding long with NO VIX gate is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the regime arm adds nothing and this is just a funding-contrarian trade. Disconfirmer 2 (sign of edge): if the edge survives ONLY in the low-VIX complement, the thesis is inverted and FAILs. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold or it is regime-luck.
catalyst: VIX elevated AND perp funding deeply negative
